finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 16; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A model step selecting between acceptance strengths through a declared branch.
why: Section 12.5 row 16, R-X19 and AS-M3-01. Acceptance-strength selection is a guard over journal state and consequence class; a model's output is an INPUT to a guard and never a jump. The mutation deletes the allow-list and leaves the explicit `!= model` conjunct -- which is the subtle case: the guard still refuses the literal string `model` while admitting any other selector kind a procedure cares to invent.
